in_scope: src/api/ - REST API endpoints (role sync, nickname, generation, member management)
src/middleware/ - Bearer token authentication, error handling
src/utils/ - Supabase client, Discord.js wrapper, logging
src/index.ts - Express server entry point, CORS config, route definitions
src/types/ - Type definitions for API and database

key_security_concerns: Input validation on all API parameters (discord_uid, generation, role_id)
No RBAC - all authenticated callers have same access level
Manual role assignment endpoints allow arbitrary Discord role grants (privilege escalation)
CORS wildcard default if ALLOWED_ORIGINS unset
Supabase key fallback from service_role to anon key
Discord API rate limiting not implemented in bulk sync
Error messages may leak internal details in non-production mode
